select e.lesson_account_id,e.class_date,e.cancel_request_status,e.enrollment_id, e.enrollment_code, e.schedule_id, e.parent_id, e.student_name, e.student_phone, e.contact_phone, e.enrollment_status, e.pay_status, e.cancel_time, e.cancel_reason, e.status, e.del_flag, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, s.grade_name, s.subject_name, s.class_type, coalesce(nullif(trim(teacher.user_name), ''), nullif(trim(teacher.nick_name), ''), s.teacher_name) as teacher_name, s.recruit_status, s.course_class_name, parent.phonenumber as parent_phone, ifnull(history.attended_lesson_count, 0) as attended_lesson_count, ifnull(history.pending_lesson_count, 0) as pending_lesson_count, ifnull(history.recorded_lesson_count, 0) as recorded_lesson_count, ifnull(history.leave_lesson_count, 0) as leave_lesson_count from edu_enrollment e left join edu_course_schedule s on e.schedule_id = s.schedule_id left join sys_user teacher on teacher.user_id = s.teacher_id left join sys_user parent on parent.user_id = e.parent_id left join ( select enrollment_id, count(distinct case when sign_status in ('1', '4', '5') and review_status = '1' then class_date end) as attended_lesson_count, count(distinct case when sign_status in ('1', '4', '5') and ifnull(review_status, '0') != '1' then class_date end) as pending_lesson_count, count(distinct case when sign_status = '2' then class_date end) as recorded_lesson_count, count(distinct case when sign_status = '3' then class_date end) as leave_lesson_count from edu_class_sign_in where del_flag = '0' and enrollment_id is not null
and exists (select 1 from edu_enrollment history_enrollment join edu_course_schedule history_schedule on history_schedule.schedule_id = history_enrollment.schedule_id where history_enrollment.enrollment_id = edu_class_sign_in.enrollment_id and history_enrollment.schedule_id = edu_class_sign_in.schedule_id and history_schedule.teacher_id = #{params.teacherUserId} and history_schedule.del_flag = '0')
group by enrollment_id ) history on history.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id
mapper.select: where e.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} and e.schedule_id is not null
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_enrollment
student_id,lesson_account_id, enrollment_code, schedule_id, parent_id, student_name, student_phone, contact_phone, enrollment_status, pay_status, cancel_time, cancel_reason, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
(SELECT student_id FROM edu_student_lesson_account WHERE account_id=#{lessonAccountId} AND parent_id=#{parentId}),#{lessonAccountId}, #{enrollmentCode}, #{scheduleId}, #{parentId}, #{studentName}, #{studentPhone}, #{contactPhone}, #{enrollmentStatus}, #{payStatus}, #{cancelTime}, #{cancelReason}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.update: update edu_enrollment set enrollment_status = '2', cancel_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} and del_flag = '0' and ifnull(enrollment_status, '1') not in ('2', '已取消')
update edu_course_schedule set enrolled_count = greatest(ifnull(enrolled_count, 0) - 1, 0), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId}

update edu_attendance set attendance_status = '2', status = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} and del_flag = '0' and attendance_status in ('0', '未上课') and attended_time is null and confirm_by is null and ifnull(confirm_name, '') = ''
